limitations: Latency only, not quality qualification. No failure, fallback or partial status is excluded when a finite cleanup_s exists.
Positive calls means recorded cleanup API calls, not proven GPU execution. Zero-call timed cases may include controller bypass or failure before a call; statuses are retained.
Native, selected MLX, E MLX and current4B are different model/precision/prompt/copy/cap/deadline systems, not backend-only comparisons.
Historical current4B and C native are single-pass observations at other times; differences are descriptive, not causal.
ABBA uses per-case median of two repeats for each system, then cohort p50/p95 on the common four-timing cohort; failures remain included.
Offline saved STT cleanup excludes capture, paste and model load. Owner language classifications are model-assisted, not human/audio truth.
Missing resources are unavailable. Physical footprint, RSS and MLX allocation are distinct observations; no shared-memory sums or ratios.
Fresh challenge results are fixed selected-model evaluation, not an independent test after model selection; no fresh header-ON arm exists. Partial-call counts use reason metadata, not generated text.

policy.comparison: Different model, precision, prompt, runtime and controls; not backend-only.
policy.header_cache: OFF for every fresh and owner native run
policy.reason: Selected-model development header-ON qualification failed before fresh evaluation.
policy.weights: Selected G fixed before fresh/owner; E-warm is a prespecified reference, not a test-driven override.
